plugins.name: Jade Cleaner
plugins.description: Cleans up tags, legends and overlaps in Revit views.
plugins.about: Revit annotation cleanup and architectural automation. Organize tags, flag overlaps, stamp floor finishes, build door and window legends, and drive Revit with Claude AI.

plugins.name: JadeTools for AutoCAD
plugins.description: Measure rooms, update area labels, assemble floor-plan DWGs, paint hatches and place review stamps.
plugins.installNotes: AutoCAD LT, Mac and Web are not supported by this package. Workflows assume millimetres; boundary tools need straight, closed 2D linework. The package reports offline validation; confirm new workflows in AutoCAD before project use.

plugins.name: Snyder Detail Library
plugins.description: Save and reuse editable Revit details and sheets, coordinate references, and assist drafting.
plugins.installNotes: Register the parent Snyder Detail Library folder in pyRevit. Details commands require your Snydex login and the office backend. Only drafting views round-trip; newer Revit detail files cannot open in older Revit. Drawing/reference tools run locally without Snydex login.

plugins.name: Jade’s Templates PSD / AI
plugins.description: Shared Photoshop entourage assets and Illustrator architectural components for presentations and graphics.
plugins.installNotes: Inside the shared folder, open Jade's Templates PSD AI. Contents listed here are based on the supplied folder screenshot; template files were not included for inspection.

plugins.name: Voronoi Pattern
plugins.description: Create a Voronoi cell pattern, scale and extrude the cells, and morph the result onto a surface.
plugins.runsIn: Rhino / Grasshopper · confirm compatibility in your installed version
plugins.installNotes: Open Voronoi Pattern_re.gh from the shared Rhino folder. Component metadata was inspected; the definition has not been executed in Rhino during this update.

tools.name: Claude AI
tools.description: Modeless Claude assistant with local parameter editing, parameter copying, type changes, rotation, moving/copying, wall creation and view operations.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › AI › AI
tools.short: Modeless Claude assistant with local parameter editing, parameter copying, type changes, rotation, moving/copying, wall creation and view operations.

tools.name: Move Leadered Dim Text
tools.description: Moves leadered dimension text to the nearest open space. Only the text moves; dimension lines and references stay unchanged.
tools.howto:
1. Open the view with crowded dimensions.
2. Click Move Leadered Dim Text. Only the text moves.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Dimensions › Move Leadered Dim Text
tools.short: Moves crowded dimension text.

tools.name: Stamp Floor Finish
tools.description: Copies the floor Type Mark beneath each placed room into its Floor Finish parameter. Requires a non-template 3D view; rerun after rooms or floors change.
tools.howto:
1. Make sure you have a non-template 3D view.
2. Click Stamp Floor Finish.
3. Run it again after rooms or floors change.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Floors › Stamp Floor Finish
tools.keywords: room finish schedule floor type mark
tools.short: Fills in room floor finishes.

tools.name: Tools Explained
tools.description: Opens the tool guide and recommended annotation-cleanup workflow.
tools.howto: Click Tools Explained to open the guide and recommended workflow.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Help › Tools Explained
tools.short: Opens the guide to all these tools.

tools.name: What Is This
tools.description: Shows the selected element's category, class, ID, tag target, and tag text. Select one element first.
tools.howto: Select one element, then click What Is This.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Help › What Is This
tools.short: Tells you what the selected thing is.

tools.name: Doors to Legend
tools.description: Creates a labelled grid of all placed door types in the active Legend view. Place one door legend component first as the formatting example.
tools.howto:
1. Open a Legend view and place one door legend component as the formatting example.
2. Click Doors to Legend.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Legends › Doors to Legend
tools.short: Makes a legend of every door type.

tools.name: Windows to Legend
tools.description: Creates a labelled grid of all placed window types in the active Legend view. Place one window legend component first as the formatting example.
tools.howto:
1. Open a Legend view and place one window legend component as the formatting example.
2. Click Windows to Legend.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Legends › Windows to Legend
tools.short: Makes a legend of every window type.

tools.name: Align & Distribute Tags
tools.description: Aligns or evenly distributes selected tags in the active view. Leadered tags align by their tag heads.
tools.howto:
1. Select the tags to line up.
2. Click Align & Distribute Tags.
3. Choose left, center, right, top, middle or bottom, or distribute evenly.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Organize › Align & Distribute Tags
tools.short: Lines up tags neatly.

tools.name: Organize Tags
tools.description: Moves wall, window, casework, multi-category, door, and room tags to nearby open spaces in the active view. Choose which tag types to organize.
tools.howto:
1. Open the plan view to clean up.
2. Click Organize Tags and tick the tag types to move.
3. Review the result on large or complex plans; Ctrl+Z undoes it.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Organize › Organize Tags
tools.keywords: clean up tags overlap clutter move tags
tools.short: Moves tags into empty space.

tools.name: Straighten Leaders
tools.description: Snaps selected tag leaders horizontally or vertically in the active view. Works with straight and elbowed leaders.
tools.howto:
1. Select tags with leaders.
2. Click Straighten Leaders and choose horizontal or vertical.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Organize › Straighten Leaders
tools.short: Makes tag leaders straight.

tools.name: Flag All Conflicts
tools.description: Finds duplicate tags and overlapping annotations in the active view, then selects flagged dimensions and view markers. Read-only.
tools.howto:
1. Open the view to check.
2. Click Flag All Conflicts. Flagged dimensions and view markers get selected. Nothing is changed.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Flag All Conflicts
tools.short: Finds overlapping and duplicate tags.

tools.name: Detect Overlaps
tools.description: Read-only annotation bounding-box candidates in the active 2D view, with clickable pair-selection and zoom links. Shift-click for dimension-related pairs only. Full dimension boxes and tag leaders may produce false positives; this does not isolate text glyphs or check model geometry. Does not move elements.
tools.howto:
1. Open a 2D view.
2. Click Detect Overlaps (Shift-click for dimension pairs only).
3. Click the links in the report to select and zoom to each pair.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Report View › Detect Overlaps
tools.short: Shows what overlaps. Click to zoom.

tools.name: View History
tools.description: Lists saved reports by date and time so you can reopen an earlier result.
tools.howto: Click View History and pick a report by date and time. Reports are saved in C:\Users\<you>\JadeToolsReports.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Report View › View History
tools.short: Reopens an earlier report.

tools.name: View Last Report
tools.description: Reopens the most recent report with clickable element links.
tools.howto: Click View Last Report to reopen the latest report.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Report › Report View › View Last Report
tools.short: Reopens the latest report.

tools.name: Count Room Tags
tools.description: Counts Room Tags in the active view.
tools.howto: Open a view and click Count Room Tags.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Count Room Tags
tools.short: Counts the room tags in this view.

tools.name: Pick Similar Dept.
tools.description: Selects every Room in the model with the same Department as the selected Room.
tools.howto:
1. Select one room.
2. Click Pick Similar Dept. Every room in the same Department is selected.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Room Select › Pick Similar Dept.
tools.short: Selects rooms in the same department.

tools.name: Pick Similar Room
tools.description: Selects every Room in the model with the same Room Name as the selected Room.
tools.howto:
1. Select one room.
2. Click Pick Similar Room. Every room with the same name in the model is selected.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Room Select › Pick Similar Room
tools.short: Selects rooms with the same name.

tools.name: Select Tags by Name
tools.description: Selects Room Tags in the active view whose rooms match the name you enter.
tools.howto:
1. Open the view.
2. Click Select Tags by Name and type the room name.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Rooms › Room Select › Select Tags by Name
tools.short: Selects room tags by room name.

tools.name: Auto Layout Views
tools.description: Arranges selected viewports inside a region you draw on the active sheet. Keeps similar view names together and centers each title below its view.
tools.howto:
1. Open the sheet and select the viewports.
2. Click Auto Layout Views and draw the region they should fill.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Views & Sheets › Auto Layout Views
tools.short: Arranges views on a sheet for you.

tools.name: Open Referring Views
tools.description: With nothing selected, finds the views referring to the view you are in. Or select a marker, one browser view, or model elements. Referring views come pre-checked: click Open ALL referring views, or untick some and click Open checked views. Quick visibility candidates avoid rebuilding every project view and may differ from Revit's native results. Verify checked is optional and checks only chosen rows. Opening never searches again. Read-only.
tools.howto:
1. Either select nothing (to search the view you're in), or select a marker, one browser view or model elements.
2. Click Open Referring Views.
3. Click Open ALL referring views, or untick some and click Open checked views.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Views & Sheets › Open Referring Views
tools.keywords: section callout elevation markers which views reference
tools.short: Opens the views that point here.

tools.name: Find + Replace View Names
tools.description: Finds and replaces text in selected view names. Preview and confirm all changes before renaming.
tools.howto:
1. Select views in the Project Browser.
2. Enter the text to find and its replacement.
3. Check the preview, then confirm.
tools.command: Jade Cleaner › Views & Sheets › Find + Replace View Names
tools.short: Renames many views at once.

tools.name: Hover Measure
tools.short: Displays enclosure areas in m² and edge lengths in mm while hovering inside…
tools.description: Displays enclosure areas in m² and edge lengths in mm while hovering inside selected straight room linework. Assumes closed 2D boundaries at Z=0; cannot trace inside xrefs.
tools.howto:
Use Model space, World UCS and Top view with millimetre linework.
Run JTHOVER and select the room boundary linework.
Hover inside rooms to read areas and edge lengths; Esc finishes.
tools.command: JTHOVER

tools.name: Area Rules
tools.short: Sets AREA_M2 on room blocks whose RM_NAME_BLINE starts with a chosen prefix
tools.description: Sets AREA_M2 on room blocks whose RM_NAME_BLINE starts with a chosen prefix. Runs on demand, rather than enforcing rules in the background.
tools.howto:
Run JTAREARULES.
Enter the room-name prefix and replacement area value.
Apply the rule and review the reported changes.
tools.command: JTAREARULES

tools.name: Paint Area
tools.short: Applies one entered area value repeatedly to room-block AREA_M2 attributes or…
tools.description: Applies one entered area value repeatedly to room-block AREA_M2 attributes or standalone area text.
tools.howto:
Run JTPAINTAREA and enter the area value.
Click each room tag or standalone area text to update.
Press Enter or Esc to finish.
tools.command: JTPAINTAREA

tools.name: Revit Plan Pack
tools.short: Combines previously exported floor-plan DWGs into a new drawing, with…
tools.description: Combines previously exported floor-plan DWGs into a new drawing, with side-by-side plans and one working layout per floor. Supports editable imports or linked xrefs; does not export from Revit or copy source title blocks.
tools.howto:
Export Revit floor-plan views as DWGs in millimetres.
Run JTPLANPACK; pick a DWG in the export folder.
Select and order floors, choose editable or linked mode, and set the spacing.
Save to a new output DWG. Check a known distance and configure PAGESETUP, title blocks and viewport scales before printing.
tools.command: JTPLANPACK

tools.name: Hatch Paint
tools.short: Paints successive enclosed rooms using one set of hatch settings
tools.description: Paints successive enclosed rooms using one set of hatch settings. Supports simple inner holes; generated boundaries do not follow later edits to original wall lines.
tools.howto:
Use Model space, World UCS, Top view and millimetres.
Run JTHATCHPAINT; choose pattern, scale, rotation, colour and transparency.
Select straight, closed room linework, then click inside rooms.
Enter or Esc finishes. Repaint rooms after boundary changes; Undo reverses the session.
tools.command: JTHATCHPAINT

tools.name: Good Job Stamp
tools.short: Places a custom message and a drawn smiley face as repeated block inserts
tools.description: Places a custom message and a drawn smiley face as repeated block inserts. Uses a non-plot layer by default.
tools.howto:
Run JTGOODJOB in Model space, World UCS and Top view.
Set the message, text height in mm, rotation, colour and plot option.
Click to place stamps; Enter or Esc finishes.
tools.command: JTGOODJOB

tools.name: Login
tools.short: Signs in to Snydex using your own account
tools.description: Signs in to Snydex using your own account. The cached session expires after about eight hours.
tools.howto:
Click Snydex › Details › Login.
Enter your Snydex username and password. Sign in again if a tool reports an expired session.
tools.command: Snydex › Details › Login

tools.name: Save Detail
tools.short: Publishes the active drafting view as a native Revit detail with a preview and…
tools.description: Publishes the active drafting view as a native Revit detail with a preview and metadata; supports updating an existing library detail.
tools.howto:
Log in and open a drafting view.
Click Save Detail, choose new or update, and complete the title/category prompts.
Save to the library.
tools.command: Snydex › Details › Save Detail

tools.name: Insert Detail
tools.short: Searches saved native details and copies one into the project as a new editable…
tools.description: Searches saved native details and copies one into the project as a new editable drafting view.
tools.howto:
Log in, then click Insert Detail.
Search and select a compatible detail.
Find and review the new drafting view in the Project Browser.
tools.command: Snydex › Details › Insert Detail

tools.name: Save Sheet
tools.short: Saves drafting views on the active sheet as a set, including viewport…
tools.description: Saves drafting views on the active sheet as a set, including viewport positions, title-block information and a sheet preview. Model-based views are skipped.
tools.howto:
Log in and open the sheet.
Click Save Sheet and complete the library prompts.
Review the saved set; only drafting views are included.
tools.command: Snydex › Details › Save Sheet

tools.name: Insert Sheet
tools.short: Rebuilds a saved detail sheet and positions its drafting views
tools.description: Rebuilds a saved detail sheet and positions its drafting views. Reuses the original title block when that family is loaded.
tools.howto:
Log in and load the required title-block family if available.
Click Insert Sheet and choose the saved set.
Review the rebuilt sheet and any view-placement warnings.
tools.command: Snydex › Details › Insert Sheet

tools.name: Auto Dimension
tools.short: Creates dimension strings for overall grids, grid spacing, walls and individual…
tools.description: Creates dimension strings for overall grids, grid spacing, walls and individual door/window openings in the active view. Review generated references and placement.
tools.howto:
Open the plan view to dimension.
Click Auto Dimension and choose the requested dimension types.
Review all generated dimensions.
tools.command: Snydex › Drafting › Auto Dimension

tools.name: AutoDimOnline
tools.short: Creates wall dimensions using all levels or a selected level, internal/external…
tools.description: Creates wall dimensions using all levels or a selected level, internal/external faces, an offset and wall-thickness/overall options. The source credits Ahmed Helmy Abdelmagid.
tools.howto:
Click AutoDimOnline.
Choose level scope, dimension face, offset in mm and dimensioning type.
Review the resulting dimensions.
tools.command: Snydex › Drafting › AutoDimOnline

tools.name: CentreTag
tools.short: Moves room location points and room-tag heads to each room’s bounding-box…
tools.description: Moves room location points and room-tag heads to each room’s bounding-box centre in the active view. This also moves the room point; for irregular rooms the box centre may be unsuitable.
tools.howto:
Open the view containing room tags.
Click CentreTag.
Review room points and tags, especially in irregular rooms; undo if the centres are unsuitable.
tools.command: Snydex › Drafting › CentreTag

tools.name: Relabel Directions
tools.short: Renames cardinal directions in view and sheet names using a fixed mapping:…
tools.description: Renames cardinal directions in view and sheet names using a fixed mapping: South → East, North → West, West → North, East → South. Appends an asterisk to updated names. Does not rotate geometry.
tools.howto:
Use only when this fixed direction mapping matches your mirrored/rotated project.
Click Relabel Directions and review the proposed names.
Confirm the rename.
tools.command: Snydex › Drafting › Relabel Directions

tools.name: Reference Filters
tools.short: Maps view templates to typology codes and uses a visibility matrix to…
tools.description: Maps view templates to typology codes and uses a visibility matrix to coordinate callout, elevation and section references. Creates reference parameters, filters and a REFERENCE CODE view list.
tools.howto:
Click Reference Filters in a project with view templates.
Assign typology codes to templates.
Set which typologies can show each reference type in the matrix.
Apply and review visibility and the REFERENCE CODE schedule.
tools.command: Snydex › Drawings › Reference Filters

tools.name: Code New Views
tools.short: Fills blank 1- VIEW CODE and 2- REFERENCED IN parameters from mapped templates
tools.description: Fills blank 1- VIEW CODE and 2- REFERENCED IN parameters from mapped templates. Keeps existing non-blank values.
tools.howto:
Run Reference Filters once to set up the project.
Create or duplicate views and apply mapped templates.
Click Code New Views and review the completion report.
tools.command: Snydex › Drawings › Code New Views

tools.name: Straighten Walls
tools.short: Analyses walls that are slightly off axis or not parallel
tools.description: Analyses walls that are slightly off axis or not parallel. Offers individual wall alignment or rotation of a whole set after analysis; changes can affect connected model elements.
tools.howto:
Select walls for a defined scope, or choose the offered view/model scope.
Click Straighten Walls and review the analysis.
Choose a fix only after checking its scope; review the model afterwards.
tools.command: Snydex › Model › Straighten Walls

tools.name: Voronoi Pattern
tools.short: Generate, extrude and surface-morph Voronoi cells.
tools.description: The definition contains surface dimensions, a rectangle, Populate 2D, Voronoi, Scale, Boundary Surfaces, Extrude, Bounding Box and Surface Morph components. It builds a planar cell pattern and maps geometry onto a target surface.
tools.howto:
Open S:\CADResources\Rhino in File Explorer and copy Voronoi Pattern_re.gh into your project folder.
Open the copied .gh file in Grasshopper.
Set the Surface input to your target Rhino surface if the saved surface is unsuitable.
Adjust the sliders connected to point count, random seed, scale and extrusion; review the pattern and mapped result.
Bake the desired output when ready to work with it in Rhino.
tools.command: Grasshopper › File › Open › Voronoi Pattern_re.gh
